body: Angular animations uses the Web Animations API, which iOS does not support. You need the [web animations polyfill](https://github.com/web-animations/web-animations-js) for it to work. Have you added it?

@hotspurs which browser are you using on desktop? Does the animation code you have work on Safari in Desktop? If not then you're missing the `web-animations` polyfill as @btaens suggested.

If you do in fact have the `web-animations` polyfill then could you provide a plnkr of your code so I can investigate?

@matsko On desktop i use chrome, firefox, safari and others. Animation works great! I have web-animations polyfill on my project.

OK, I will provide plnkr a little bit later.

issue.body:
This patch removes the need to include the Web Animations API Polyfill
(web-animations-js) as a dependency. Angular will now fallback to using
CSS Keyframes in the event that `element.animate` is no longer supported
by the browser.

In the event that an application does use `AnimationBuilder` then the
web-animations-js polyfill is required to enable programmatic,
position-based access to an animation.

Closes #17496
